How shopping the yard works

No accounts, no waiting on a delivery truck — most customers are loaded up and back on the road the same visit.

1

Call or stop by

Tell us what your job needs — shingles, plywood, siding or nails. We'll confirm what's on the stack and give you a free estimate on the material.

2

Pick your material

Choose your bundles, sheets and fasteners right at the yard — brands like Owens Corning and GAF, sold by the bundle, the sheet, or the box.

3

Load up & go

We help you get loaded and you're back on the road to the job. Leftover material from a finished job? Bring it by — we buy material too.

Questions customers ask

The quick answers — for anything else, call the store and we'll sort it out.

Do you install roofs, or sell material?
We're a roofing supply store — we sell the material: shingles, plywood, siding and nails. Contractors and homeowners buy from us and handle the install. We also buy material, so leftover stock from a finished job can come back to the yard.
Are estimates really free?
Yes — free estimates. Call (713) 433-7501 or stop by the yard, tell us what your job needs, and we'll help you price the material before you commit.
What are your hours?
We're open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 6:30 PM, and closed on Sundays. The yard gets busy, so calling ahead to check stock is always a good idea.
Do you buy leftover material?
We buy and sell material. If you've got shingles, plywood, siding or nails left over from a finished job, bring them by the yard or call us first and ask what we'll pay.
